company: July 1776 broadside printing of the Declaration of Independence (seller Jeremy, New York)
product: Pawn Stars clip 'MILLION DOLLAR DEAL for the Declaration of Independence (Season 19)' (YouTube id tcABhDUp_Z4, Pawn Stars official channel, episode 'Declaration of Indepawndence'). Rick travels to New York. Seller asks $2 million. Expert Seth Kaller confirms 100% legit, says it could go for $2 million at auction. Rick offers $1.4 million citing auction fees, seller $1.5 million, Rick meets in middle at $1.45 million - deal.

facts.fact: Rick: one of the most historical documents on the planet, original Declaration of Independence broadside; probably only 20 left in private hands.
Seller: extremely rare July 1776 printing; sourced from a private collection, never sold at public auction; displayed at the National Constitution Center in Philadelphia.
Pinholes in the corners show it was displayed publicly; they were never meant to be saved.

facts.source: broadcast transcript ids 55-60; on-screen price tag $2,000,000

facts.fact: Expert Seth Kaller (historic documents dealer) had authenticated this exact copy before; nail holes handmade; couple hundred printed on night of July 4-5, sent out by John Hancock; this copy was posted on a wall.
Expert: 100% legit, could go for $2 million at auction now.
Negotiation: Rick cites ridiculous auction fees, offers $1.4 million; seller $1.5 million; Rick meets in the middle at $1.45 million; deal. Rick: 'I own the Declaration of Independence.'
facts.source: broadcast transcript ids 122-137; on-screen tags was $2,000,000 / now $1,400,000 / $1,500,000 / $1,450,000; https://marketrealist.com/what-was-the-value-of-a-copy-of-the-declaration-of-independence-on-pawn-stars

facts.fact: No confirmed record found of what Rick did with the broadside after the show.
